title: .NET Developer
description: A roadmap for building modern .NET applications with C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, testing, cloud deployment, and maintainable APIs.

tree.name: C# and .NET Foundations
tree.description: Learn C#, the .NET runtime, OOP, collections, LINQ, async programming, project files, and dependency management.

children.name: C# Language Core
children.description: Use classes, records, interfaces, generics, LINQ, nullable references, exceptions, pattern matching, and async/await.

children.name: .NET CLI and Tooling
children.description: Manage projects, packages, solution structure, configuration, logging, debugging, and local development workflow.

tree.name: ASP.NET Core APIs
tree.description: Build web APIs with controllers or minimal APIs, middleware, DI, validation, auth, OpenAPI, and HTTP fundamentals.

children.name: Minimal APIs and Controllers
children.description: Create endpoints, bind requests, return typed results, handle errors, version APIs, and generate OpenAPI docs.

children.name: Entity Framework and Auth
children.description: Use EF Core, migrations, relationships, transactions, Identity, JWT, roles, and secure configuration.

children.name: Practice: Clean API Slice
children.description: Implement one vertical API slice with endpoint, validation, EF Core model, tests, auth rule, and logs.

tree.name: Testing and Architecture
tree.description: Write maintainable .NET services with tests, architecture boundaries, background jobs, observability, and resilience.

children.name: Unit and Integration Testing
children.description: Use xUnit, mocks, WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, coverage, and CI test reports.

children.name: Background Jobs and Resilience
children.description: Run hosted services, queues, retries, health checks, structured logs, metrics, and resilient HTTP clients.

tree.name: Deployment and Portfolio
tree.description: Ship .NET APIs with containers, cloud hosting, database migrations, monitoring, and production documentation.

children.name: Cloud Deployment
children.description: Deploy to Azure App Service, containers, or VMs with environment config, secrets, health checks, and logs.

children.name: Project: Inventory Management API
children.description: Build an ASP.NET Core API with EF Core, auth, role permissions, tests, Docker, CI, OpenAPI, and deployment notes.
